name: carbon-frappe
description: Carbon Design System theme for Frappe
author: Avunu LLC

scripts.build: node scripts/patch-assets.ts --warn-only && node scripts/audit-tokens.ts --warn-only && node scripts/audit-markup.ts --warn-only && node scripts/build-ai-chat.ts
scripts.codegen: node scripts/sync-fonts.ts && node scripts/generate-chart-palettes.ts && node scripts/generate-icons.ts
scripts.audit:drift: node scripts/audit-tokens.ts --strict && node scripts/audit-markup.ts --strict && node scripts/build-ai-chat.ts --check
scripts.lint:py: uv run --frozen --project tools ruff check . && uv run --frozen --project tools ruff format --check .
scripts.check: yarn -s format:check && yarn -s lint && yarn -s lint:css && yarn -s typecheck && yarn -s test:unit
scripts.upgrade: npx npm-check-updates -u && yarn install && yarn build
